description: This is a test class for the ImplementationIdValidator, containing unit tests that validate the behavior of the ImplementationIdValidator class, focusing on input validation rules and error handling.

classes.name: ImplementationIdValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImplementationIdValidator, testing validation rules and error handling behaviors.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfImplementationIdIsNUll
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws an APIException when the ImplementationId object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfImplementationIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the validator adds an error when the ImplementationId's 'implementationId' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when only 'implementationId' and 'passphrase' are set, and 'description' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPassPhraseIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that an error is raised when the 'passphrase' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenEmptyImplementationIdObject
methods.description: Checks that validation fails and errors are added for a completely empty ImplementationId object.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenACaretInTheImplementationIdCode
methods.description: Tests that a caret character in 'implementationId' data triggers a validation error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfGivenAPipeInTheImplementationIdCode
methods.description: Tests that a pipe character in 'implementationId' triggers a validation error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that validation fails and errors are added when the 'name' field of ImplementationId is null.
